comments.author: Juicebox
comments.body:
So I Tested this skill out here are some things you should know...

1.This is a passive skill that makes it so livestock give birth more in your hold. 100 cattle one will give birth now you have 101.

2 IMPORTANT. This does NOT work on all livestock this only works on BASIC livestock all others will not reproduce ever. Basic Livestock is Cattle,Chickens,Ducks,Sheep, Pigs and Goats. All others will not reproduce.

3. The rate in which animals reproduce INCREASES the higher the number of days you are at sea. I have been in sailing almost 60 days and the livestock was giving birth every 2-4 days.

4. When the animals give birth only get 1 extra offspring at a time...

5. You DONT have to be moving for this to work. MAYBE works if you are shipwrecked also

In my opinion this is not worth a ship slot unless maybe you literally keep an alt outside port just breeding livestock I guess. But for what you can simply just get more just buying it in port. IF it worked on all livestock it would at least be a little useful for newbies but I can foresee some losers using their alts and this method to farm Nanban goods so I get why it only work on basic livestock.

Ummm Not Worth it.
